page.layout: One printed page. Top: page number 48 at upper left, then centred title DE NOMINUM FINIBVS, and a German subtitle line. Below: a Latin paragraph with a German continuation. Then a bracketed list of Italian name endings (left bracket, "In" label) and a second bracketed list of endings with a vertical side label in the left margin ("Nom. prop. Urbium Viril. gener. terminantur in") at the lower left. Catchword-like closing word "Nomi" at the lower right.

main_text.head: DE NOMINUM FINIBVS. Von denen Endigungen der Namen oder Nennwörter.
main_text.p: Nomina substantiva propria virorum & Num. fingul. exeunt, in eigene Männer Namen Exempel, in singul. Num. wie sie sich im Italiänischen endigen, Als,
main_text.l: In A. Enea, Pitagora, Luca, idem Andrea, Porsena.
I. Parigi, Brindisi, Ragusi, Paris, Brundis, Ragusa.
O. Milano, Como, Pesaro, Meyland, Cemen, Pisauer.
V. Corju, Cefalu, Peru, Corfun, Cephallen, Perus.

page.notes: The left-margin vertical label reads "Nom. prop. Urbium / Viril. gener. terminantur in". Some Italian forms in the lists are partly illegible due to print quality and the italic type; the bracketed list grouping is reconstructed from the layout. The "Nomi" at lower right is a catchword.
